teaser.en: One of Kenya's rarest trees hides in the Shimba Hills and Kwale kayas, its white flowers on extraordinarily long tubes.
teaser.sw: Mmoja wa miti adimu kabisa nchini Kenya umejificha katika milima ya Shimba Hills na kaya za Kwale, ukiwa na maua meupe yaliyo kwenye mirija mirefu ajabu.

summary.en: *Mnyandza* is a rare tree of lowland rainforest, with two-lobed leaves and large white flowers on very long tubes. It is listed as Endangered and survives in only a few coastal forests, including the Shimba Hills and the Kwale kayas.
summary.sw: *Mnyandza* ni mti adimu wa misitu ya mvua ya nyanda za chini, wenye majani yenye pande mbili na maua makubwa meupe yaliyo kwenye mirija mirefu sana. Umeorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini (Endangered) na unapatikana tu katika misitu michache ya pwani, ikiwemo Shimba Hills na kaya za Kwale.

about.en: *Mnyandza* has leaves split into two lobes, like those of the *Bauhinia* or camel's-foot trees it is related to. Its flowers are large and white, sitting at the end of a very long, slender tube, the feature that gives the genus its name, *Gigasiphon*, 'giant tube'.
about.sw: Majani ya *mnyandza* yamegawanyika katika pande mbili, kama ya miti ya *Bauhinia* au *camel's-foot* ambayo ni jamaa zake. Maua yake ni makubwa na meupe, yakiwa mwishoni mwa mrija mrefu na mwembamba sana, sifa iliyoipa jenasi hii jina lake, *Gigasiphon*, yaani 'mrija mkubwa'.

where.en: It grows in lowland rainforest between about 30 and 600 metres above sea level. On the south coast it is found in the Shimba Hills and the Kwale kaya forests.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya mvua ya nyanda za chini, kati ya takriban mita 30 na 600 juu ya usawa wa bahari. Katika pwani ya kusini hupatikana Shimba Hills na katika misitu ya kaya ya Kwale.

uses.en: No particular use for *mnyandza* has been recorded.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mnyandza*. No Swahili or English name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mnyandza*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.

conservation.en: Mnyandza is listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List and is restricted to a few coastal forests, so the protection of the kayas and the Shimba Hills matters for its survival.
conservation.sw: Mnyandza umeorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini (Endangered) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN na unapatikana tu katika misitu michache ya pwani, kwa hiyo kulindwa kwa kaya na Shimba Hills ni muhimu kwa kuendelea kuwepo kwake.

reason.en: Camel's foot, with similar two-lobed leaves
reason.sw: Msegese, wenye majani ya pande mbili yanayofanana

reason.sw: Mti mwingine adimu wa misitu ya Shimba Hills
